relations.subject: n1ql:simple-array-expression
relations.evidence: Couchbase Server 5.0 and later provides a simpler syntax for array indexing when all array elements are indexed as is, without needing to use the `ARRAY` operator in the index definition.

relations.subject: n1ql:unnest-alias-flexibility
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 6.5 and later, you can use any arbitrary alias for the right side of an UNNEST — the alias does not have to be the same as the ARRAY index variable name in order to use that index.
